notes.title: Pivross is a 3D picross game that still needs some work
notes.notes:
Pivross is a 3D picross game, which is – and someone will correct me if I’m wrong – the first of its type on PC. That is what piqued my interest. It is, unfortunately, not nearly as good as it needs to be. But then again, the first fifth is free, so you can find out for yourself without risk.
(more…)

notes.title: First day... first update!
notes.notes:
Initial feedback was players were struggling with the controls being too fast.  A quick update has been made to include a rotation slow / medium / fast option and the default speed slowed.

I hope this helps and everyone enjoys the game!
